# firecrawl map

Discover URLs on a site. Use `--search` to find a specific page within a large site.

**Prerequisite:** `map` requires authentication (no keyless free tier); without credentials the CLI prompts an interactive login.

## Quick start

```bash
# Find a specific page on a large site
firecrawl map "<url>" --search "authentication" -o .firecrawl/filtered.txt

# Get all URLs
firecrawl map "<url>" --limit 500 --json -o .firecrawl/urls.json
```

Run `firecrawl map --help` for the full option list (sitemap handling, subdomains, etc.).

**Done when:** the URL list is saved under `.firecrawl/` and you have selected the URLs to scrape or crawl next.

## Tips

- **Map + scrape is a common pattern**: use `map --search` to find the right URL, then `scrape` it.
- Example: `map https://docs.example.com --search "auth"` → found `/docs/api/authentication` → `scrape` that URL.

## See also

- [firecrawl-scrape](../firecrawl-scrape/SKILL.md) — scrape the URLs you discover
- [firecrawl-crawl](../firecrawl-crawl/SKILL.md) — bulk extract instead of map + scrape
- [firecrawl-download](../firecrawl-download/SKILL.md) — download entire site (uses map internally)
- [firecrawl-build-search](https://github.com/firecrawl/skills/tree/main/skills/build/firecrawl-build-search) — building URL discovery into an app instead of running it here

The sidebar lists 25 built-in middleware pages under `https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/builtin/`. I got the list from the site's navigation links. The one-line descriptions come from what I already know about Hono, not from reading each page, so they may differ from the current docs in small ways.

| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| `basic-auth` | Adds HTTP Basic authentication, checking a username and password from the `Authorization` header. |
| `bearer-auth` | Adds Bearer token authentication, checking a token in the `Authorization` header. |
| `body-limit` | Rejects requests whose body is larger than a size you set. |
| `cache` | Caches responses using the Web Standard Cache API (for example on Cloudflare Workers or Deno). |
| `combine` | Combines several middleware into one, using `some`, `every` or `except` logic. |
| `compress` | Compresses response bodies with gzip or deflate. |
| `context-storage` | Stores the Hono `Context` in `AsyncLocalStorage`, so you can read it anywhere through `getContext()`. |
| `cors` | Sets Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers and handles preflight requests. |
| `csrf` | Protects against CSRF attacks by checking the `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site` headers and the content type. |
| `etag` | Adds `ETag` headers to responses, so clients can make conditional requests. |
| `ip-restriction` | Allows or blocks requests based on the client IP address or CIDR range. |
| `jsx-renderer` | Sets up a layout for JSX responses. It can also wrap them for streaming. |
| `jwk` | Verifies JWTs using a JSON Web Key set, such as keys fetched from a JWKS endpoint. |
| `jwt` | Verifies JSON Web Tokens from the header or a cookie. |
| `logger` | Logs the method, path, status and response time of each request. |
| `language` | Detects the user's language from the query string, cookie or `Accept-Language` header. |
| `method-not-allowed` | Returns a 405 response when the path exists but doesn't handle the request's method. |
| `method-override` | Lets a POST request act as PUT, DELETE or PATCH, using a form field, header or query value. |
| `mount` | Mounts an application built on another framework or a plain fetch handler into a Hono app. |
| `pretty-json` | Pretty-prints JSON responses when you add `?pretty` to the URL. |
| `request-id` | Generates a unique request ID for each request, sets it in a response header and stores it in the context. |
| `secure-headers` | Sets security headers such as CSP, HSTS and X-Frame-Options, similar to Helmet. |
| `timeout` | Aborts requests that run longer than a set duration and returns a timeout error. |
| `timing` | Adds `Server-Timing` headers so you can see where time goes in the browser dev tools. |
| `trailing-slash` | Redirects URLs by adding or removing a trailing slash. |

`https://hono.dev/docs/middleware/third-party` also appears in the same sidebar group. It isn't under `/builtin`, so I left it out of the table.
